preparationBenchmark.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/ltlly/Code/paseo/target CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build --locked --offline --manifest-path /home/ltlly/.cache/paseo-native-qa/glyph-bench/Cargo.toml; then run target/debug/paseo-glyph-bench on isolated DISPLAY=:94. The source and manifest are copied alongside this file.
preparationBenchmark.profile: paseo-glyph-bench and GPUI opt-level=2, with other existing dev-profile dependencies. This is not a whole-application release build.
preparationBenchmark.method: Prepopulate real TerminalBuffer and GPUI font layouts, compare original/cached shaped results, then count allocations/reallocations around 100 traversals of the same borrowed grid. Run both preparation paths against the same WindowTextSystem. Pixel paint/GPU/transport cost is outside this measurement.
preparationBenchmark.allocationScope: Cumulative requested bytes, not live memory or process RSS. Unicode and style cases retain temporary text allocations for combining-cell key materialization.
preparationBenchmark.debug: The unoptimized cache implementation is roughly equal in this stage, with a small Unicode slowdown in the recorded sample. Do not infer a debug-build speedup.

budgetAndRelease.scope: Bounds cache residency, not total terminal memory. GPUI glyph/layout/atlas ownership is separate.

adjacentRuntimeSamples.method: Same isolated visible terminal, 16ms updates to first row over populated ASCII grid, 2s warmup and about 5s process sampling, fresh client per source. Final pair taken without active builds or benchmark processes. Native debug executable, lavapipe software rendering.
adjacentRuntimeSamples.conclusion: No established meaningful overall CPU or RSS improvement. One adjacent pair and software rendering are insufficient for overall acceptance. Earlier exploratory samples had build/benchmark overlap and are excluded.

limitations: Full GPUI migration, original Electron UI pixel parity and full terminal fidelity remain incomplete.
Cross-cell shaping, grapheme/fallback fidelity and explicit trailing-space copy gaps remain unchanged.
This checkpoint does not validate hardware GPU latency, overall memory savings, real Pi/Grok workloads or Mac/Windows native interaction.
The font database is loaded before any native window in the current application; appearance and dynamic font loading remain migration work.
Raw-byte input, shared replay-mode edge cases, reconnect, full IME/keyboard, word/line/autoscroll/context menus, images and remaining transports/splits remain required.
